reports.title: The Local Government Finance Act [CAP. 290 R.E. 2019]
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance and Planning, United Republic of Tanzania
reports.description: Tanzania's national statute governing Local Government Authority own-source revenue. Verified via direct PDF download and text extraction. Section 6(1)(u) (urban authorities): "all monies derived from the service levy payable by corporate entities or any person conducting business with business licence at the rate not exceeding 0.3 percent of the turnover net of the value added tax and excise duty" (an equivalent clause for district councils appears at Section 7(1)(y)). Section 31A(1): "Notwithstanding the provisions of this Act, the Tanzania Revenue Authority shall have the obligation to evaluate, assess, collect and account for property rate and advertisement fees for billboards, posters and hoarding" — property rate is listed as an LGA revenue category (Sections 6(1)(o)/7(1)(z)) but its evaluation/assessment/collection was statutorily reassigned to the national Tanzania Revenue Authority, meaning LGAs no longer administer this own-source revenue line themselves.
reports.cadence_note: One-off foundational legal instrument (R.E. 2019 = Revised Edition 2019).

reports.title: Taarifa ya Mapato ya Ndani ya Halmashauri kwa Kipindi cha Nusu Mwaka (Julai–Desemba) 2018/19

NOTE: the site's own menu label reads '...2028' while the resolved URL slug and document body both consistently say 2018/19 — an internal site-labeling inconsistency, not treated as authoritative against the document's own body text.

DROPPED 2026-09-05 on Thomas's ruling, applying the 2026-08-31 ruling 1-A (assertion-only edges are _dropped, never live). The edge was minted at C and its own basis declared the defect: the DCC budget page never names the Local Government Finance Act, by title or by section, and the edge rested on the two documents sharing a revenue-category framework. That is a belief about how the figures relate, not a document naming one as the other's input. The finding itself survives and is worth re-working: DCC's page gives an own-source revenue share (48% of TSh 372,740,857,951.00 for FY2026/27) whose categories the Act establishes, so a DCC document that cites Cap. 290 by name — the budget-summary attachment behind the site's JS fetch is the obvious candidate, never retrieved — would mint this edge properly. Original basis, preserved verbatim: "DCC's own-source revenue figure (48% of total estimated revenue for FY2026/27) is the aggregate outcome of the own-source revenue categories (service levy, property rate before its 2019 TRA reassignment, and others) the Local Government Finance Act establishes, though the budget page itself does not quote the Act by name/section — recorded as 'cites' on the strength of the shared revenue-category framework rather than a direct textual citation." Evidence URL was https://www.dcc.go.tz/mpango-na-bajeti-2026-27. Consequence: tz-dar-es-salaam-city-council-budget-2026 now carries no edge and is isolated. The node stands — it is a real, quoted, dated council document — but nothing documented depends on it or it on anything.
